harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name. The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and the clause «له ما في السماوات» is the ṣila of the relative noun. «ما»: mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate). The implied form is: [Praise be] to Allah, Him to whom what is established in the heavens belongs. The clause «وهو الحكيم» is conjoined to the ṣila clause.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «يعلم» is a third khabar (predicate) of the preceding «هو». The clause «وهو الرحيم» is conjoined to the clause «يعلم», and «الغفور» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «بلى»: a particle of answer. His words «وربي»: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; «ربي» is the thing sworn by, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) «أقسم» ("I swear"), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). «عالم»: naʿt (adjective) of «ربي». The clause «لا يعزب عنه مثقال» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ربي». The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to a naʿt of «ذرة». His words «ولا أصغر»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negating, «أصغر» is a noun conjoined to «مثقال». «إلا» is for restriction. The preposition «في كتاب» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: except that it is in a Book; the clause is resumptive, meaning: rather, all things are in a Book.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, «ليجزي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ}. The clause «أولئك لهم مغفرة» is resumptive, and the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The wāw in «والذين» is resumptive. «معاجزين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «سعوا». The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين», and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «ويرى الذين» is resumptive. His words «الذي أنزل» are the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يرى», and «الحق» is the second object; «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). The clause «ويهدي» is conjoined to «الحق», of the type of conjoining clauses to single words, i.e.: they see [it as] the truth and guidance. «الحميد»: naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «ينبئكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل». «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, i.e.: you will be resurrected. It is not attached to his words «إنكم لفي خلق جديد», because what comes after «إنَّ» does not govern what precedes it. The conditional clause is parenthetical between the verb and its object. The clause «إنكم لفي خلق» takes the place of the second and third objects of the verb «ينبئكم», and «إن» is given kasra because of the presence of the lām in the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) of «افترى» was dropped when it met the interrogative hamza. «أم» is a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction. The clause «أفترى» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «أم به جنة» is conjoined to the clause «أفترى». The clause «الذين لا يؤمنون» is resumptive, and the preposition «في العذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The hamza is interrogative and the fāʾ is resumptive. The adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The preposition «من السماء» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the two relative nouns. The conditional clause is resumptive. The second preposition «من السماء» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كسفا», and the preposition «لكل» is attached to a naʿt of «آية». The clause «إن في ذلك لآية» is resumptive, and the lām is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The preposition «منَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فضلا». The clause «يا جبال» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech, the implied form being: our saying; and the implied [word] is a badal (substitute) of «فضلا». His words «والطير»: a noun conjoined to the position of «جبال». His words «معه»: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl from the yāʾ in «أوِّبي». The clause «وأَلَنَّا» is conjoined to the clause «آتينا».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «أن» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām. «سابغات» is of the type where the described noun is omitted and the adjective kept, i.e.: full-length coats of mail (دروعًا سابغات). «صالحا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «اعملوا» is conjoined to the clause «قَدِّر». The clause «إني بصير» is resumptive, and the preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: His words «ولسليمان الريح»: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (سخَّرنا, "We subjected"); «الريح» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied «سخَّرنا», and the clause «سخَّرنا» is resumptive. The clause «غدوها شهر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الريح». The clause «وأَسَلْنَا» is conjoined to the clause «سخَّرنا», and the clause «ومن الجن من يعمل» is conjoined to the clause «سَخَّرْنا». The preposition «بإذن» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «يعمل», and the preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يَزِغْ». The clause «ومن يَزِغْ» is resumptive, and «من» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «يعملون» is explicative of the work of the jinn before him. The preposition «من محاريب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما», and the preposition «كالجواب» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جِفان». «شكرا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: perform acts of obedience; good deeds are called gratitude because they are among its kinds. The clause «اعملوا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech, and this speech is resumptive. His words «وقليل»: the wāw is resumptive, «قليل» is a khabar (predicate) placed first and «الشكور» a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the clause is resumptive, and the preposition «من عبادي» is attached to a naʿt of «قليل».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «ما دلَّهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «تأكل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «دابة الأرض». The second conditional clause is conjoined to the first. His words «أن لو»: «أن» is lightened from the heavy [أنَّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن لو ...» is the object of «تبينت» in the sense of "knew". The clause «لو كانوا...» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the clause «ما لبثوا» is the apodosis of «لو».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «لقد كان» is the answer to the oath. The preposition «في مسكنهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آية». «جنتان»: badal (substitute) of «آية». The preposition «عن يمين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جنتان». The clause «كلوا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied, resumptive speech. His words «بلدة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this [is]; and «رب»: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: and the Bestower [is] a Lord. The clause «هذه بلدة» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فأعرضوا» is resumptive. His words «جنتين»: second object, and the bāʾ entered upon what is given up. «ذواتَيْ»: naʿt (adjective), accusative with the yāʾ. The preposition «من سدر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «شيء».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: His words «ذلك»: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «جزى», placed first. «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جزى», i.e.: We recompensed them for their disbelief. The clause «وهل نجازي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «وجعلنا» is conjoined to the clause {جَزَيْنَاهُمْ}. «بينهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object. «التي»: naʿt (adjective). «قرى»: the first object of «جعلنا». The clause «سيروا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech that is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, i.e.: saying. «ليالي»: an adverb of time attached to «سيروا», and «آمنين»: ḥāl from the wāw in «سيروا».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فقالوا» is resumptive. The clause «وظلموا» is conjoined to the clause «قالوا», and the clause «فجعلناهم» is conjoined to the clause «ظلموا». «كل» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «ولقد صدَّق عليهم» is resumptive, and the clause «فاتبعوه» is conjoined to the clause «صدَّق». «فريقا»: excepted. The preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فريقا».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the answer to the oath. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the preposition «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «سلطان». «وسلطان» is the noun of «كان», and «ومن» is redundant (zāʾida). «إلا» is for restriction. «لنعلم»: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive, is attached to the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar of «كان» is attached, i.e.: there was no authority existing for him except so that We might know. The preposition «ممن» is attached to «نعلم» in the sense of "distinguish"; the preposition «منها» is attached to a ḥāl from «شك»; and the preposition «على كل» is attached to «حفيظ».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of the implied second object, i.e.: you claimed them [to be] gods existing besides Allah; the two objects of «زعم» are implied. The clause «لا يملكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين», i.e.: call them while they possess nothing. The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to a naʿt of «مثقال ذرة». The clause «وما لهم من شرك» is conjoined to the clause «لا يملكون»; «شرك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «فيهما» is attached to a ḥāl from «شرك». «ظهير» is a mubtadaʾ and «من» is redundant; the preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl from «ظهير».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The wāw is a conjunction, and the clause «لا تنفع» is conjoined to the clause {لا يَمْلِكُونَ}. «عنده»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الشفاعة». «إلا» is for restriction. The preposition «لمن» is attached to a ḥāl from «الشفاعة». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive. The preposition «عن قلوبهم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا»: a relative noun, khabar (predicate). «الحق»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied [verb], i.e.: they said: He said the true word. The clause «وهو العلي» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «الله»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: [is] the Provider. His words «إياكم»: a detached pronoun conjoined to the noun of «إن». The clause «وإنَّا لعلى هدى» is conjoined to the clause (الله الرازق).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «لا تسألون» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «وهو الفتاح العليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: His words «أروني»: [from the verb of] sight, transitive to one object before the transfer [to the causative form], and after the transfer it became transitive to two: the yāʾ of the speaker and the relative noun. «شركاء»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun referring back to the relative noun, i.e.: make me see those you attached to Him, as being partners [of mine]. «كلا»: a particle of rebuke and deterrence. The clause «بل هو الله» is resumptive, and «العزيز الحكيم» are multiple predicates (akhbār).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «وما أرسلناك» is resumptive. «كافة»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) for intensiveness; it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) on the pattern fāʿila, like «العافية». The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «كافة». «بشيرا»: ḥāl from the kāf. The clause «ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «ما أرسلناك».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «متى»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «هذا»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «لا تستأخرون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ميعاد يوم». «ساعة»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «بين يديه»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ولو ترى» is resumptive; the apodosis of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: you would have seen a wonder; and the object of «ترى» is omitted, i.e.: you see the state of the wrongdoers. The clause «الظالمون موقوفون» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «يرجع بعضهم» is a second khabar (predicate). The adverb «عند» is attached to «موقوفون». The clause «يقول الذين» is resumptive. «أنتم»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar is omitted, the implied form being "present" (موجود).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The adverb «بعد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صددناكم». «إذ»: an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct), and the clause «جاءكم» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «كنتم مجرمين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause that is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, its implied form being: we were not criminals; rather... His words «مكر»: fāʿil (agent) of an implied verb, i.e.: your scheming in these two times turned us away. «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (مكر). The interpreted maṣdar «أن نكفر» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The conditional clause «لما رأوا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وأسَرُّوا» is conjoined to the clause «قال الذين». The clause «وجعلنا» is conjoined to the clause «رأوا». The preposition «في أعناق» is attached to the second object of «جعلنا». «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, second object of «يجزون».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وما أرسلنا» is resumptive; «نذير» is the object of «أرسلنا», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «قال مترفوها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قرية»; what permitted the one it describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl) to be indefinite is that a negation precedes it. The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «أموالا»: tamyīz (specification). «ما» is a negating particle acting like «ليس», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate). The clause «وما نحن بمعذبين» is conjoined to the clause «نحن أكثر».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «ولكن أكثر» is conjoined to the clause «إن ربي يبسط».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The wāw is resumptive. «ما» is a negating particle acting like «ليس». The preposition «بالتي» is the khabar (predicate), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); it [«التي»] is an adjective of «الأموال» and «الأولاد», because a broken plural of non-rational beings is treated as a feminine singular. «عندنا»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «زلفى». «زلفى»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) synonymous with its governing word. «من»: a relative noun, excepted in a disjoined exception. The clause «فأولئك لهم جزاء» is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the maṣdar «بعملهم» is attached to the maṣdar (جزاء). The clause «لهم جزاء» is the khabar of «أولئك». The clause «وهم آمنون» is conjoined to the clause «لهم جزاء», and the preposition «في الغرفات» is attached to «آمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The wāw is resumptive. «معاجزين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw. The clause «أولئك محضرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». The preposition «في العذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محضرون».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The conditional clause «وما أنفقتم» is conjoined to the clause «إن ربي». «ما»: a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. The preposition «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». The clause «وهو خير الرازقين» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive, and «يوم» is an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) «اذْكُر» ("remember"). The clause «يحشرهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). «إياكم»: a detached accusative pronoun, object of «يعبدون» placed first. The clause «كانوا» is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «سبحانك»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: we glorify [You], glory be to You. The preposition «من دونهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «ولينا». The clause «كانوا» is resumptive. The clause «أكثرهم مؤمنون» is resumptive, and the preposition «بهم» is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: His words «فاليوم»: the fāʾ is resumptive, «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يملك». The preposition «لبعض» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نفعا». The clause «ونقول» is conjoined to the clause «لا يملك». The preposition «بها» is attached to «تكذبون».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «بينات»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آياتنا». The clause «يريد» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is the object of «يريد». The preposition «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يصدَّكم». The second clause «وقالوا» is conjoined to the first, and «مفترى» is a naʿt of «إفك». The clause «وقال» is conjoined to the clause «وقالوا». The clause «لما جاءهم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «إن» is negating, and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The wāw is resumptive. «كتب»: second object of «آتيناهم», and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «يدرسونها» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «وما أرسلنا» is conjoined to the clause «وما آتيناهم»; «نذير» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «وكذَّب» is conjoined to the preceding resumptive [clause] «وما آتيناهم». The preposition «من قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). «ما»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «فكيف كان نكير» is conjoined to the clause «كذَّبوا». «كيف»: an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of «كان», and «نكير» is the noun of «كان», nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تقوموا» is a badal (substitute) of «بواحدة». «مثنى»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw. The clause «ما بصاحبكم من جنة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of reflection, which carries the sense of knowing and is suspended [from operating] by the negation. «جنة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «بصاحبكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «جنة». The clause «إن هو إلا نذير» is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to «نذير», and likewise the adverb «بين».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His words «من أجر»: second object of «سأل», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «ما»: conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فهو لكم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «إن أجري إلا على الله» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «وهو على كل شيء شهيد» is conjoined to the clause «إن أجري إلا على الله». The preposition «على كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيد».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «يقذف» is made to carry (mudammin) the sense of "decrees" (يقضي), and the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يقذف». «علام» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وما يبدئ الباطل» is conjoined to the clause «جاء الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: His words «فبما»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and «ما» in his words «فبما» is maṣdar-forming; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e.: my being guided is by revelation.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: His words «ولو ترى»: the wāw is resumptive, «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle, the object of «ترى» is omitted, i.e.: their state, and the apodosis of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: you would have seen a wonder. His words «إذ»: an adverb used in a future context because its occurrence is certain. The clause «فزعوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The clause «فلا فوت» is conjoined to the clause «فزعوا», and the khabar (predicate) of «لا» is implied, i.e.: for them. The clause «وأخذوا» is conjoined to the clause «فزعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: His words «وأنَّى»: the wāw is parenthetical, «أنى» is an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) placed first, and «التناوش» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (التناوش), and the preposition «من مكان» is attached to the maṣdar (التناوش). The clause «وأنى لهم التناوش» is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) clause and the one it describes.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «وقد كفروا به» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) in «قالوا», and the clause «ويقذفون» is conjoined to the clause «كفروا».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «وحيل بينهم» is conjoined to the clause {فَزِعُوا}. The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «حيل» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb, i.e.: the intervening was made to intervene (حِيل الحَوْلُ). «بينهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. His words «كما»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdar-forming, i.e.: an intervening was made like Our doing with their kind.
